paragraphs: Netacent sells Data Station, an unemployment insurance system for state agencies. The homepage calls it an all-inclusive solution covering timely and accurate payments, fraud prevention, and access to the system for both claimants and employers. That work is framed against disruptions due to COVID-19 that left state unemployment insurance agencies with backlogs of claimants, overloaded call centers, and potential for fraud.

The about page dates the company to 2013, when unemployment insurance and software engineering experts came together to bring a core unemployment insurance solution to State Workforce Agencies (SWA) across the nation. Those same leaders were responsible for the modernization of the unemployment insurance platform in the State of Idaho in 2014. Netacent was born out of that effort, according to the about page.

The system was built from the ground up with Cloud Computing and Software as a Service delivery models, and the about page calls the result the Data Station unemployment insurance platform. When laws change and new UI programs are added, the system is maintained and updated automatically, the homepage says.

quote.text: Data Station is an all-inclusive solution that provides methods to enable timely and accurate payments, fraud prevention, and easy access to the system for both claimants and employers.
